string.text: You want to live the romantic life of the rogue, is that it? Listen, lass. Any fucking wankstain with a peashooter can go around like a common thug if he likes. He can wind up dead in a ditch too, for all I care. You want to be a bandit? You want to live the good life? Bring 5,000 RU as tribute, swear fealty to me as your Sultan and I'll let you tag along with my merry men.
You've impressed me, lass. Wish more of the boys around here had your spunk.
I'm in desperate need of new tools, girl. I can't do anything with the rusty shit I have and I'm running out of gun oil. If you are interested in helping me out, I will tell you what I need.
Perfect! This is just what I need, girl. I can properly upgrade gear now!
You followed through again! Good deal, girl, here is some money.
